a private placement offering targeting gross proceeds of up to C$2M if fully subscribed.
The offering includes Units at C$0.05, FT Units at C$0.055, and CMFT Units at C$0.06 each.
The company plans to issue ~35M to 40M units, depending on the mix of securities sold.
Up to 10M Units will be offered at C$0.05 each, generating up to C$500,000 in gross proceeds.
Each Unit consists of one common share and one purchase warrant exercisable at C$0.12 per share.
The Unit warrants expire after 24 months or earlier if Grizzly's shares trade at or above C$0.18 for 10 consecutive trading days.
The financing is intended to provide additional capital for the company's activities, with the final proceeds dependent on subscription levels and unit mix.

title: Grizzly Discoveries announces up to $2M private placement
